notes:
Features
- Updates itself: a new version is offered at start-up, and About > Check for Updates checks now
- Windows file servers as well as Azure Files (no Azure sign-in needed for file servers)
- Storage Locations: click a location to see its share and NTFS permissions, with an FSLogix check (Azure Files: the share's Storage File Data roles)
- Settings: switches for the permissions pane and the FSLogix check
- Profile Cleanup: folders to exclude from cleanup (wildcards allowed)
- When only one storage location is configured, it is ticked by default

Fixes
- Profile Locks no longer shows your own admin account's open files as locks
- Sharp folder icon in the taskbar
